    Co-hyperlinear IRS / amenable-trace dictionary #

    This file states the MIP*-free operator-algebraic dictionary around invariant random subgroups used in Manzoor, arXiv:2502.06697.

    The intended mathematical layer is:

    • an IRS H of a free group Γ gives a trace τ_H(g) = P(g ∈ H);
    • H is co-hyperlinear iff τ_H is amenable, i.e. matrix-microstate approximable;
    • for free Γ, this is equivalent to Connes embeddability of L(Γ/H) := τ_H(Γ)'';
    • for a Dirac IRS δ_N, this recovers hyperlinearity of the quotient Γ/N;
    • co-sofic IRSs are co-hyperlinear.

    Mathlib does not currently expose the full measure-theoretic standard Borel space of subgroups, the universal group C*-algebra, or the von Neumann double-commutant/GNS completion needed to construct τ_H(Γ)'' natively. We therefore take the deliberately lighter trace-level route: an IRS Γ is packaged as its conjugation-invariant positive definite trace character, together with an ambient tracial C*-algebra realizing that character on a group representation. This avoids a vacuous carrier while leaving the measure-to-trace construction and the GNS/double-commutant construction as downstream formalization targets.

      structure ZFib.CEP.IRS (Γ : Type u) [Group Γ] :
      Type (u + 1)

      Trace-level invariant random subgroup data.

      Rather than constructing a probability measure on the standard Borel space Subgroup Γ, this structure records the trace character induced by the IRS, its conjugation invariance, its positive-definiteness, and an ambient tracial C*-algebra realization. The intended trace is traceCharacter g = P(g ∈ H).

      • A : Type u
      • instCStarAlgebra : CStarAlgebra self.A
      • instPartialOrder : PartialOrder self.A
      • instStarOrderedRing : StarOrderedRing self.A
      • ρ : GroupCStarRepresentation Γ self.A
      • τ : TracialState self.A
      • traceCharacter : Γ → ℂ
      • traceCharacter_eq (g : Γ) : self.traceCharacter g = self.τ.toPositiveLinearMap ↑(self.ρ.toUnits g)
      • trace_one : self.traceCharacter 1 = 1
      • trace_conj (a g : Γ) : self.traceCharacter (a * g * a⁻¹) = self.traceCharacter g
      • positive_definite (n : ℕ) (g : Fin n → Γ) (c : Fin n → ℂ) : 0 ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, star (c i) * c j * self.traceCharacter ((g i)⁻¹ * g j)).re

              structure ZFib.CEP.IRSVonNeumannAlgebra {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] (H : IRS Γ) :
              Type (u + 1)

              The trace/GNS-level stand-in for L(Γ/H) := τ_H(Γ)''.

              At this draft layer we keep the generated von Neumann algebra as a bundled tracial C*-algebra with the canonical group map and trace compatibility. The full GNS closure and double-commutant construction should replace this scaffold when the needed Mathlib von Neumann algebra API is available.

                        structure ZFib.CEP.FiniteIRSModel {Γ : Type u} [Group Γ] (H : IRS Γ) (F : Finset Γ) (ε : ℝ) :
                        Type (u + 1)

                        A finite permutation approximation to the IRS trace character on a prescribed finite set.

                        The value approximated is the stabilizer trace: for a finite action, the probability that g fixes a random point.
